title: Exact closed restriction on arbitrary element sites
statement: For a commutative ring sheaf R, actual element restriction has a natural derived internal-Hom comparison. Further restriction along every sheaf arrow admits the exact additive, K-injective, unit and derived-Hom data of RingedPresentationCore, with identity unit. For each site object U the module category on C/U is equivalent to the module category on the element site of the sheafified representable of U; its forward unit and derived Hom are compatible and the usual overFunctor corresponds to element restriction. Actual restriction additivity, exactness, colimits, K-injectivity, element-map continuity and relocalization are already proved in RingedPresentationData and are not asserted as unfinished parts here.

proof.text: Use the already proved presentationElementRestriction_additive, _exact and _kInjective API theorems for actual element restriction. Its sectionwise formula sends the regular module to itself with identity unit comparison. Continuity and relocalization are also already proved in the same data module; the unfinished content begins with the derived-Hom comparison.

At (U,a) the further slice of the element site is C/U: the section on V→U is forced by restriction of a. Therefore sectionwise sheaf Hom commutes with restriction. Products commute as well, so the Hom complex and its signed differential commute with restriction. Compute derived Hom using a K-injective target and its restricted K-injective target. The representing comparisons are natural in both arguments.

For B→A, repeat the closed restriction calculation on the element site of A, obtaining the further-restriction core and its identity regular-unit comparison. Relocalization and element-map continuity are supplied by the proved data API. Over h_U#, the fibre/extension equivalence identifies localized sheaves with element-site sheaves. Transport module operations through its fibres; the restricted ring is R|U and ordinary restriction is the same functor under this equivalence. The preceding Hom calculation gives its forward closed comparison; the parent derives the reverse formally.

theorem element_restriction_hom
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    ∃ (s : ∀ {A B : Sheaf J (Type u)} (b : B ⟶ A),
        RingedPresentationCore (presentationElementRing R A) (presentationElementRing R B)
          (elementModulePullbackOver.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) b
            (presentationElementRestriction_continuous b))),
      (∀ A : Sheaf J (Type u),
        Nonempty (presentationRHom R ⋙
          presentationDerivedMap (R := R) (S := presentationElementRing R A)
            (elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) A)
            (presentationElementRestriction_additive R A)
            (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).1
            (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).2.1 ≅
          ((presentationDerivedMap (R := R) (S := presentationElementRing R A)
            (elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_additive R A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).1
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).2.1).op.prod
            (presentationDerivedMap (R := R) (S := presentationElementRing R A)
            (elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R) A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_additive R A)
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).1
              (presentationElementRestriction_exact R A).2.1)) ⋙
            presentationRHom (presentationElementRing R A))) ∧
      (∀ {A B : Sheaf J (Type u)} (b : B ⟶ A), (s b).unit = Iso.refl _) ∧
      ∀ U : C,
        ∃ E : RingedPresentationEquivalenceCore (R.over U)
          (presentationElementRing R ((presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U))),
          Nonempty (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (localCoefficientRings R) U ⋙
            E.modules.functor ≅ elementModulePullback.{u, u} (localCoefficientRings R)
              ((presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U)))
